name: Ja'Marr Chase

background.fact: Born March 1, 2000 in Harvey, Louisiana; attended Archbishop Rummel High School in Metairie, Louisiana, where he had 115 receptions for 2,152 yards and 30 touchdowns, and was a 4 star recruit ranked 84th overall.

He committed to Kansas, then Florida, then LSU. At LSU in 2019 he led the FBS with 1,780 receiving yards and 20 touchdowns, won the Fred Biletnikoff Award and the national championship, and set a playoff championship game record with 221 yards against Clemson.
He opted out of the 2020 college season to prepare for the NFL, reportedly on the advice of agents so he would not risk injury.

Cincinnati drafted him fifth overall in 2021. He was NFL Offensive Rookie of the Year, a second-team All-Pro, played in Super Bowl LVI, and in 2024 won the receiving triple crown (most receptions, yards and touchdowns).
Listed at 6 ft 0 in, 205 lb, age 26, jersey 1; combine 40-yard dash 4.34 and 41 inch vertical; Madden week 8 overall rating 99.

Contract: the Bengals signed him to a four-year extension reported at $161 million (about $112 million guaranteed per Jordan Schultz), running through 2029, the largest deal for a non-quarterback at the time. The data file's contract record only shows his 2021 rookie deal, so this comes from the news report.

scouts_read: Chase shows no injury designation in the sources I could reach, so I expect him to play a full game, though the final Friday report was not found and I would check it before kickoff. He has caught a touchdown in four straight games and is coming off a 155 yard day, but his average of 13.3 points is held down by modest home games and the Jacksonville game he left early. Pittsburgh won the first meeting 30-27 and uses zone coverage, and Higgins is nearly level with him in targets, so his volume depends on how much Burrow throws. A home game with a 49.5 point total and a three point spread should keep Cincinnati's passing game busy. I would project a solid game in the mid teens with a touchdown the most likely route to a big day.
